title: Large-Facility Portfolio Bonus on the Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credit
content:
Businesses whose large facilities are under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts earn more on the renewal loyalty credit of their small business sites.

**Portfolio bonus.** On the renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, a business holding an active Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract adds 60.00 dollars; a business whose Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract is pending enrollment adds 30.00 dollars; a business holding neither adds nothing.

## Records read

The business's Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts records and their status. The contract need not be at the same site as the renewed small business agreement.

| Status of the business's Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts contract | Portfolio bonus |
|---|---|
| active | 60.00 USD |
| pending enrollment | 30.00 USD |
| neither (none held, or only closed or expired ones) | none |

## Hypothetical businesses

- A grocery chain with three small business sites and an active commercial and industrial contract on its distribution centre: 60.00 USD on the renewed site's loyalty credit.
- A clinic group whose commercial and industrial contract for a new hospital wing is still pending enrollment: 30.00 USD.
- A café with no commercial and industrial contract: nothing.
